event: Small-ticket SMS sale encountered unexpected top-up economics.
result: Observed that acquisition/recarga costs could erase margin.
lesson: Always calculate real total cost before treating a nominal sale price as profitable.

event: Long WhatsApp messages were revised into short channel-native messages.
result: A dedicated short-message process was documented.
lesson: Communication quality depends on channel conventions and conversation context.

event: Facebook public replies were automatically rejected and private messaging was later restricted.
lesson: Platform policy and account-health risk must be part of the decision model; do not route around restrictions.

event: Many research/publication steps occurred without a confirmed sale.
result: Activity increased faster than economic outcome.
lesson: Session completion must require a real outcome or meaningful operational leap.

event: Manual confirmations were being refined to avoid stopping the agent too often.
result: A smaller set of human checkpoints was identified.
lesson: Batch human interventions and continue independent work instead of stopping at every blocker.
